request.raw_text: Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.

bottom and sides of the device
functional_intention_words: might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch

aim.primary_aim: Add a 20 cm by 10 cm, 3 cm deep rounded-rectangular opening to the lower back of the coffee machine, positioned approximately equally from its bottom and sides.

functional_design_intentions.name: Provisional plug and switch location

validation_criteria.description: The opening has a first profile dimension of 20 cm.
The opening has a second profile dimension of 10 cm.
The rectangular opening has rounded corners with a 1 cm radius.
The opening is located on the lower back of the coffee machine and is approximately equally distanced from the bottom and sides.
The opening provides a potential location for a plug and the main ON/OFF switch.
The opening provides localized rear space suitable for potential component placement or access.
Geometry outside the local lower-back opening remains unchanged.
